entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: 497 aa; predicted molecular mass 57.0 kDa and theoretical pI 5.95.
Strong homology to reviewed kynureninases: 76.2% identity over 89.5% query coverage to Schistosoma japonicum Q5DGJ1; E-value 4.11e-262.
Pfam KYNU_C domain detected at residues 393-487.
Function is inferred primarily from homology; exact substrate preference is not experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: Kynureninase
observations: Cleaves L-kynurenine to anthranilate and L-alanine; also cleaves 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine to 3-hydroxyanthranilate and L-alanine.
Commonly annotated as a cytoplasmic enzyme and homodimer.
A conserved lysine forms the pyridoxal-phosphate linkage in reference kynureninases.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5-phosphate
observations: Required cofactor for kynureninase activity; ChEBI:CHEBI:597326.

entities.name: Tryptophan-kynurenine metabolism
observations: Kynureninase participates in L-tryptophan catabolism and kynurenine degradation.
The reaction supplies anthranilate and connects kynurenine metabolism to de novo NAD+ biosynthesis through the quinolinate branch.
